full_prompt_en: A square delicate painted illustration shows a dark-haired young woman in three-quarter view before an ornate circular floral ground, all in muted cream, sepia, and charcoal. The background is a warm tan field packed with fine vines, pale blossoms, and curling stems. A thin circular ring behind the head organizes the ornament into a soft halo without separating it sharply from the rest of the pattern. The woman occupies the center-right from shoulders upward, head turned toward the left while the eyes look slightly outward. Her short dark bob curves around the cheeks and lifts into soft strands at the ends; heavy bangs cross the forehead. The face is pale and smooth, with finely shaded brown eyes, a small straight nose, and parted rose-beige lips. A dark high-collared jacket covers the neck and shoulders, and tiny round fasteners or seams catch muted highlights near the collar. Wisps of hair cross the cheek, keeping the otherwise composed portrait from feeling rigid. The surrounding flowers are drawn with thin brown contour lines and lightly filled petals, while the figure's hair and clothing provide broad dark masses. Light is soft and even from the upper left, lifting the cheek and forehead but creating only a gentle shadow under the chin. Fine printed grain and subtle paper warmth remain visible throughout. The overall composition balances a quiet modern face with antique botanical intricacy and a restrained tonal rhythm.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形细腻绘画插图描绘一名黑发年轻女子以四分之三角度立在繁复圆形花卉背景前，整体是柔和奶油色、深褐与炭色。背景为暖棕黄色域，填满细藤、浅色花朵和卷曲花茎。头后一道细圆环把装饰组织成柔和光圈，却没有与其余纹样鲜明割裂。女子从肩部以上占据中央偏右，头转向左，眼睛略向外望。短黑波波头绕过双颊，发尾翘起柔软发丝；厚刘海横过额头。面容浅而平滑，有细致阴影的棕眼、小而直的鼻子，以及微张的玫瑰米色嘴唇。深色高领夹克覆盖颈肩，领旁微小圆扣或接缝接住柔和亮光。几缕发丝横过脸颊，让原本沉静的肖像不显僵硬。周围花朵由细棕轮廓线和浅着色花瓣绘成，人物头发与衣服则提供宽阔深色体量。光从左上方柔和均匀地照亮脸颊和额头，只在下巴下方产生温和阴影。细微印刷颗粒与纸张暖意处处可见。整体构图以安静的现代面孔平衡古典植物纹样的繁密，形成克制色调节奏。
style_prompt_en: The image has a delicate painted-and-ink illustration finish on warm paper, with fine branching linework and smoothly modeled focal planes. Cream, tan, sepia, charcoal, and faint dusty rose make a narrow low-saturation palette. Thin circular guides and curling contours organize dense peripheral pattern around a simpler dark-and-light center. Broad matte shapes anchor the image while small line details remain airy rather than heavy. Light is diffuse and even, allowing subtle rounded tonal gradients and paper grain to coexist with precise outline. Edges soften slightly into the warm background, and shallow layers overlap without strong perspective. The overall effect is intimate, refined, and quietly ornamental.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有暖纸上的细腻绘色与墨线插图质感，细致分枝状线描和平滑塑形的焦点平面并存。奶油色、棕黄、深褐、炭色与淡灰玫瑰形成狭窄低饱和色域。细圆形导线与卷曲轮廓把密集外围纹样组织在更简单的深浅中心周围。宽阔哑光形状稳住图像，小线条细节保持通透而不厚重。光线漫射均匀，让微妙圆润的色调渐变与纸纹同精确轮廓共存。边缘略柔化进暖背景，浅层次重叠而无强透视。整体效果亲密、精致且安静地富装饰性。
theme_en: A dark-haired young woman before an ornate circular floral ground
theme_zh: 繁复圆形花纹背景前的黑发年轻女子
name: Audrey Kawasaki
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
